shared_elements: frontal or profile human figures in schematic outline
justification: Both depict engraved human figures with arms raised or extended, but A shows large isolated stick-like frontal figures with orant arms amid free-floating lines, while B shows a formally organised two-register scene of seated and standing figures in profile flanking an offering table, with rows of script-like signs. The only correspondence is the generic one of schematic incised human figures; the compositional conventions (registers, profile posture, offering relationship, writing) are entirely absent from A.
